name: Chinese Egg, Tomato & Green Onion Stir-Fry with Sesame Seeds over Rice

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
12 tomatoes
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a large bowl.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise, then cut into ½-inch thick wedges. Add to the bowl with the ginger and garlic, then set aside.
Crack eggs into another large bowl. Add salt, then beat with a whisk or fork until smooth.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green onions (reserving a small handful for serving) and cook, stirring frequently, until beginning to soften, about 30 seconds.
Add eggs to the pot and cook, stirring frequently, until just set, about 4 minutes. Remove to a plate. (Reserve pot for the next step.)
Return pot to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tomatoes and soy sauce; cook, stirring occasionally, until beginning to soften, about 4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
⅓ cup soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place water, ketchup, chili-garlic sauce, cornstarch, and sugar in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup water
3 tbsp ketchup
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 tbsp cornstarch
1 tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Once the tomatoes have softened, reduce heat to medium. Add sauce and continue to cook, stirring frequently, until sauce thickens slightly, 3-4 minutes.
Return eggs to the pot, using a spoon to break them up. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice and stir-fry between plates or bowls. Top with reserved green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!
